title: event.deviceidentity.cert-revoked.v1.payload
description: Metadata-only notification: a device certificate was revoked. Consumers MUST refetch via the status endpoint to obtain current certificate state. No certificate body is carried on the bus.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier; omitted for single-tenant deployments

reason.description: RFC 5280 §5.3.1 CRLReason code. Full standard set retained for provider-neutral alignment; consumers should treat certificateHold/removeFromCRL per RFC 5280 semantics (hold / un-hold), not as permanent revocation.

revokedAt.description: Timestamp when the certificate was revoked (RFC 3339)

actorId.description: Principal ID of the actor who triggered revocation
